data.title: 厄普西隆 · 闺阁明镜前的自豪测量
data.description: 私密寝阁华丽金边穿衣镜前，厄普西隆单手叉腰，一手按在胸前史莱姆软垫上仔细校准曲线，扬起尖下巴露出绝对自信的得意笑容。
data.location: opulent private bedchamber with gilded full-length cheval dressing mirror and plush curtains
data.action: standing before mirror, one hand checking breast curve line, the other hand on hip, admiring reflection with proud smug blushing smirk
data.lighting: 晨曦落地窗光与梳妆台暖灯
data.promptProse: Epsilon in a silk dressing chemise stands before her ornate full-length mirror, hands adjusting her curves with an adorably smug blushing smile.
data.animaCaption: Morning mirror reflections capture her proud, self-satisfied adjustments.
